hook.text: Re-reading your notes feels like studying. It isn't. Recall turns your notes into questions, marks your answers in your own words, and shows you what you really know. Its AI runs on your device and in the cloud, as a team.

add.text: Paste your notes, snap a photo of a page, or drop in a PDF. Firebase AI Logic routes each job. Notes and photos go to Gemini Nano, built into Chrome, with prefer on device. A PDF goes to the cloud. One structured output format serves both: a response constraint on the device, a response schema in the cloud.

factcheck.text: Then a second, larger cloud model fact-checks every card against your notes. It has to quote its evidence, and plain code checks every number. This card says fifty-nine percent. The notes say ninety-five. So it's flagged, with a fix.

study.text: Studying starts with a commitment: how sure are you? Then answer, typed or spoken. Chrome's on-device speech recognition writes your words into the box, so your voice never leaves the device. Gemini Nano marks the answer right here, with only on device: instant, free, private, and offline too.

audit.text: But can a small model be trusted? Recall checks itself. Every mark is weighed for doubt. Doubtful marks go to the larger cloud model before you see them, and a sample of confident ones is spot-checked. Agreement becomes Nano's trust score, so the more it earns, the less ever leaves your device.

tutor.text: Missed a point? Talk it through. The tutor is a Firebase AI Logic chat session, streaming on Nano. Ask a bigger model, and the same conversation hands off to Gemini in the cloud, with every reply badged by where it ran.

gauntlet.text: Each day, the Trap Gauntlet turns your mistakes into a game. Nano writes true statements and traps, on the device. While you race the clock, a cloud model referees every statement in parallel, and withdraws any unfair one, live. Honest confidence earns you XP.

voice.text: Questions can be read aloud by Gemini's text-to-speech, through Firebase AI Logic, streamed so it starts in about a second. That's the voice you're hearing now.

engine.text: The AI engine page shows the router, live. Go offline, and marking, tutoring and the gauntlet stay on the device, while PDFs wait in a queue. Private mode forces only on device. Models come from Remote Config, and App Check protects every cloud call.

close.text: Small, private, instant work on the device. Rare, heavy work in the cloud. And a measured line between them. That's Recall.
